facts.fact: Priority households get 5 kg of foodgrains per person per month under NFSA
facts.quote: priority households are entitled to 5 kg per person per month.

facts.fact: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) households get 35 kg of foodgrains per household per month
facts.quote: While AAY households, which constitute poorest of the poor are entitled to 35 kg of foodgrains per family per month

facts.fact: The grain is free of cost under PMGKAY, extended for five years from 1 January 2024
facts.quote: The period of distribution for free of cost food grains under the PMGKAY has been extended for five years w.e.f. 1st January, 2024.

facts.fact: The Rs 3/2/1 per kg prices (rice/wheat/coarse grains) applied before free distribution began and are not current
facts.quote: Prior to that, under NFSA, subsidized food grains were distributed at Rs 3 per kg for rice, Rs 2 per kg for wheat and at Rs 1 per kg for coarse grains to beneficiaries.

summary: All confirmed: 5 kg/person/month (PHH) and 35 kg/household (AAY) on nfsa.gov.in; free under PMGKAY for five years from 1 Jan 2024 and Rs 3/2/1 as the earlier price in PIB's DFPD Year End Review 2025 (31 Dec 2025).
